integrity: The proof is analytic. The checker only corroborates the reciprocal-sum inequality on finite samples and verifies algebra; finite computation is not used as proof. Literature comparisons are limited to the searches and source inspections documented in the review.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a universal lower bound for uniform multimode thermal Gaussian steady states and displacement sensing relative to bath equilibrium. For \(N>1\) it does not claim physical attainability of the trace-only equality spectrum, global sharpness under symplectic and Lyapunov constraints, a state-dependent passive-reference analogue, a non-Gaussian extension, or entanglement-enabled optimality.
title: Multimode displacement sensitivity forces an explicit entropy-production cost
